sfre_subtitle: Analytical measurements under stated uncertainty. Not investment advice and not an allegation about any person or company. Models are UNCALIBRATED unless governance says otherwise; unobserved data is never treated as zero.
sfre_no_datasets: none: no observations ingested yet (golden-case replay stays BLOCKED_NO_DATA)
sfre_as_of_hint: Only data that was available by the end of this day is used.
sfre_no_universe: No fund data as of this date. Upload TEFAS, holdings and BIST files in the Data tab.
sfre_seed_hint: Same data + same seed = same result hash.
sfre_run_note: The run uses ingested point-in-time data. Leverage, margin and counterparty exposure are usually unobserved and are listed, never assumed zero.
sfre_kind_tefas_hint: Workbook with “Genel Bilgiler” (price, units, investors, AUM) and “Portföy Dağılımı” (allocation) sheets.
sfre_kind_bist_eod_hint: Columns: symbol, date, close, volume (shares). Optional: open, high, low, turnover.
sfre_kind_free_float_hint: Columns: symbol, date, free-float ratio or shares (and paid-in capital if shares are absent).
sfre_kind_holdings_hint: Columns: fund code, date, stock code, weight %. Set the real publication lag below.
sfre_lag_hint: Data counts as known only after report date + lag. Wrong lag = look-ahead leakage.
sfre_reconciled: both views reconcile to the total
sfre_lower_bound: Lower bound: some channels are unobserved and excluded.
sfre_json_hint: Raw request body for /api/sfre/runs (manual fund system).
